The severity of the structural collapse is arguably underestimated; the mechanical logic is completely nonsensical, which is a hallmark of AI generation failure for complex objects. I will maintain the severity at 3.5-4.0 range as it renders the object non-functional but visually coherent as *some* object.

The classifier's positive signal is overridden by the visual evidence of missing functional components (lenses, eye cup, folding mechanism).
